command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd opsadmin >/dev/null; then
  useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin
fi
install -d -m 0700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
printf '%s\n' 'ssh-rsa [REDACTED_ENCODED_BLOB] legacy-ops@example.invalid' > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 0600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
passwd -l opsadmin >/dev/null
restorecon -RF /home/opsadmin/.ssh 2>/dev/null || true
getent passwd opsadmin
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /home/opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
passwd -S opsadmin
ssh-keygen -lf /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
